summary: Baseline (incumbent recipe, scratch) stuck in the start room: 250 u (0.44%) at 76M, peak 121 u/s; its yaw sigma saturates at the clamp (2.72) because the start room pays nothing. The start is an energy gate: the room's exit is a window 50-110 u above the floor; the WR pumps in the east halfpipe first (+1,520 u potential dip). Running side by side: sid_ref weights-only warm start (pbr1b3_sidwarm) and 4x novelty from scratch (pbr1b3_nov4). Next: energy shaping everywhere, or whichever arm moves the frontier.
